# BOARD MEETING MINUTES

**DATE: October 21, 2026**

A meeting of the Malden Retirement Board was held this day October 21, 2026, at 8:36AM in conference room #105 at Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St. Malden, MA with the following present: Warren Atkinson Jr., John Hall, Scott Lucey, Charles Ranaghan, Craig Spadafora (Remote Attendance). Staff: Director, Robert Soohoo, and Board Secretary Maria LoGrasso. Guests: Scott & Scott, Donald A. Groggi & Jonathan M. Zimmerman. Cambridge Trust, Jeffrey Smith, Phillip McManus, Brian Bickford, and Ryan Hanna. Daniel Grover, Treasurer.

## Call to Order

The Chairman, Mr. Atkinson called the meeting to order at 8:36 AM. The Board Secretary Maria LoGrasso took an attendance roll call vote.

Mr. Atkinson Jr. - Yes

Mr. Hall - Yes

Mr. Lucey - Yes

Mr. Ranaghan - Yes

Mr. Spadafora (Remote)- Yes

## Introduction of guests from Scott + Scott

Donald A. Groggi and Jonathan M. Zimmerman introduction of guests. Scott & Scott discussed the Dick's Sporting Goods securities fraud case and representing the fund on that matter. Presentation ended at 8:54 AM.

## Presentation

Jeffrey Smith, Philip McManus, and Kirk Allen, Ryan Hanna from Cambridge Trust presented the 3Q 2026 performance of the portfolio.

## Review of Board's Investment Policies and in Compliance with PERAC

The Board discussed Pooled funds investments with Cambridge Trust which is not in compliance with PERAC. The Board discussed divesting and farming out the sleeve of funds to be compliant with PERAC. The Board requested a call with PERAC, Cambridge Trust, and our attorney, two Board members TBD, and the Retirement Director to discuss options. Discussion ended at 9:43 AM.

## General Meeting

**Accept September Board Meeting Minutes, October Expense Warrant, September Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, September Cash Books & Cash Reconciliation.**

**VOTE:** To accept September Board Meeting Minutes, October Expense Warrant, September Retiree Payroll and Staff Payroll Warrant, September Cash Books & Cash Reconciliation. Motion by Mr. Hall and seconded by Mr. Ranaghan, it was voted: The Board Secretary Maria LoGrasso took an attendance roll call vote.

Mr. Atkinson Jr. - Yes

Mr. Hall - Yes

Mr. Lucey - Yes

Mr. Ranaghan - Yes

Mr. Spadafora (Remote)- Yes

Motion passed.
